cards.name: Abstruse Appropriation
cards.oracleText:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Exile target nonland permanent. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and you may spend colorless mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.

cards.name: Dragon's Approach
cards.oracleText:
Dragon's Approach deals 3 damage to each opponent. You may exile Dragon's Approach and four cards named Dragon's Approach from your graveyard. If you do, search your library for a Dragon creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
A deck can have any number of cards named Dragon's Approach.

cards.name: Gird for Battle
cards.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.

cards.name: Press the Advantage
cards.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn.

cards.name: Approach of the Second Sun
cards.oracleText: If this spell was cast from your hand and you've cast another spell named Approach of the Second Sun this game, you win the game. Otherwise, put Approach of the Second Sun into its owner's library seventh from the top and you gain 7 life.

cards.name: A-Prosperous Thief
cards.oracleText:
Ninjutsu {1}{U} ({1}{U}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.)
Whenever one or more Ninja or Rogue creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.")
